name: scratched-metal
notes: Worn metal as a dual-gated triple: one merged scratch history (55% near-linear, 45% deep-swirl strokes; heavy-tailed lengths, widths and depths) thresholded at 30/55/80% core coverage - the damage dial. Linear-only and swirl-only ancestors were merged on review: same material, different tools, one texture. Levels 30/55/80 = light/medium/heavy, calibrated to core-band stroke coverage by tools/fractal-tip.mjs --calibrate; verified by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. REVISED to a tonal mask (maskMode tonal): the tip carries the tone-mapped field itself rather than a threshold cut, value-curve deconvolved by the mask train's overlap (v = 1-(depth*damage)^(1/n)); the level number is now the damage/modulation DEPTH, not coverage - moderate damage renders as moderate contrast over intact paint.
